DATA INCIDENTS.

1 Incident Notification. If Alaio becomes aware of a Data Incident, Alaio will: (a) notify Administrator of the Data Incident promptly and without undue delay; and (b) promptly take reasonable steps to minimize the harm and secure Personal Data.

2 Details of Data Incident. Notifications will describe, to the extent possible, details of the Data Incident, including steps taken to mitigate the potential risks and steps Alaio recommends Administrator take to address the Data Incident.

3 Delivery of Notification. Alaio will deliver its notification of any Data Incident to the Notification Email Address or, at Bitrix24 discretion, by other direct communication (for example, by phone call or an in-person meeting). Administrator is solely responsible for ensuring that the Notification Email Address is current and valid.

4 Third Party Notifications. Administrator is solely responsible for complying with breach notification laws applicable to Administrator and fulfilling any third party notification obligations related to any Data Incident.

5 No Acknowledgement of Fault by Alaio. Alaio notification of or response to a Data Incident will not be construed as an acknowledgement by Alaio of any fault or liability with respect to the Data Incident.

Alaio will implement and maintain the Security Measures set out in this Appendix 2. Alaio may update or modify such Security Measures from time to time, provided that such updates and modifications do not result in the degradation of the overall security of the Processor Services.

GOVERNANCE & RISK
Data Center risk management. The AWS Security Operations Center performs regular threat and vulnerability reviews of data centers. Ongoing assessment and mitigation of potential vulnerabilities is performed through data center risk assessment activities. This assessment is performed in addition to the enterprise-level risk assessment process used to identify and manage risks presented to the business as a whole. This process also takes regional regulatory and environmental risks into consideration.
Third-party security attestation. Third-party testing of AWS data centers, as documented in our third-party reports, ensures AWS has appropriately implemented security measures aligned to established rules needed to obtain security certifications. Depending on the compliance program and its requirements, external auditors may perform testing of media disposal, review security camera footage, observe entrances and hallways throughout a data center, test electronic access control devices, and examine data center equipment.

Data Transmission . Alaio Datacenters are connected via private links protected by AWS Network firewalls to provide secure data transfer. Data Breach Response . Alaio monitors a variety of communication channels for security breaches, and Alaio  security personnel will react promptly to known incidents.
External Attack Surface . Alaio considers potential attack vectors and incorporates appropriate purpose built proprietary technologies into external facing systems.
Encryption Technologies . Alaio uses HTTPS encryption (also referred to as SSL or TLS connection).

Administrator may object to any new Sub-processor by notifying Alaio promptly in writing within five (5) business days after receipt of Alaio notice.
